kbuild.rust_config_prompt: Rust reference driver for LSI ET1011C PHY
rust_help: Uses the Rust reference driver for the LSI ET1011C PHY (et1011c_rust.ko).
The features are equivalent to the C driver.

translation.goal: Constrain the first `drivers/net/phy/et1011c_rust.rs` to a minimal, artifact-driven Rust PHY driver covering registration, `config_aneg`, and `read_status`.
translation.abstraction_goal: Constrain the first PHY round so `et1011c` can land through existing Rust PHY abstractions plus the minimal missing `genphy_config_aneg` wrapper, without introducing driver-side `unsafe` or direct `bindings::*`.

mvp_scope.note: The stage-1 oracle for this PHY round is module load/unload. Hardware-attached behavior is still represented statically by callback/body planning and compile-time validation.

body_plan: Read `C22::BMCR`, clear duplex/speed/autoneg bits, issue reset, then call `dev.genphy_config_aneg()`.
Keep all register access within `phy::Device` and `reg::C22`.
If the vendor status register reports gigabit mode, rewrite the config register through safe register access only.
Do not translate the C `static int speed` literally; keep state derivation local to the callback.

private_state.note: The stage-1 `et1011c` Rust PHY driver should not introduce per-device Rust private state.
